panel.heading: Updates
panel.autoCheckDescription: Checks GitHub for a newer Stable release shortly after startup, then about once an hour. Never downloads or installs anything on its own.
panel.developmentBuildNotice: Updates are available in packaged release builds.
panel.platformUnsupportedNotice: Automatic updates are not yet available on this platform. You can always download the latest release manually from GitHub.
panel.manualBuildNotice: Manual/test build — automatic updates are unavailable for this build.

state.checkFailed: The last check could not complete. It will be retried automatically.
state.noReleaseYet: No Stable release has been published yet.

install.confirmMessage: Streaming Tree will close, install the update, and restart. This only takes a moment.

blocked.install_blocked_streaming_active: Stop the active stream before installing the update.
blocked.not_installed_context: This copy of Streaming Tree cannot install updates automatically.
blocked.no_verified_candidate: The update has not finished downloading yet.
blocked.platform_unsupported: Automatic installation is not available on this platform yet.
blocked.manual_build: This is a manual/test build. Automatic updates are unavailable for it.
blocked.generic: The update cannot be installed right now.

error.check_failed: Could not check for updates. This will be retried automatically.
error.rate_limited: Too many update checks recently. This will be retried automatically.
error.invalid_manifest: The release information from GitHub could not be verified.
error.download_failed: The update could not be downloaded.
error.hash_mismatch: The downloaded update failed verification and was discarded.
error.size_exceeded: The update download was larger than expected and was cancelled.
error.install_failed: The update could not be installed. Your existing installation is still available.
error.generic: Something went wrong with the updater.

postUpdate.failure: Update could not be installed. Your existing installation is still available.
